task_text: A guest is coming over in 15 minutes. The house should feel welcoming — somewhere comfortable to sit, and something to offer them when they arrive.

plans.R1:
Based on the images and the capabilities of agent R1, here's a plan to prepare for the guest:

[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin. (r1_s1)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the tomato from the counter. (r1_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the mug on the counter near the coffee machine. (r1_s3)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the tomato on a plate on the counter. (r1_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the lettuce from the counter. (r1_s5)
- R1 [LOCAL] Place the lettuce next to the tomato on the plate. (r1_s6)

This plan ensures there is something to offer the guest (a tomato and lettuce) and a mug ready for a drink.
plans.R2:
Based on the images of the living room, here's a plan to make the space welcoming for the guest:

[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Push the armchairs closer to the coffee table to create a cozy seating area. (r2_s1)
- R2 [LOCAL] Pickup the box from the coffee table and place it on the side table to clear space. (r2_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Pickup the decorative vase from the coffee table and place it on the TV cabinet for a tidier look. (r2_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] Adjust the position of the floor lamp to ensure the seating area is well-lit. (r2_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place a few magazines or books from the TV cabinet onto the coffee table for the guest to browse. (r2_s5)
- R2 [LOCAL] Ensure the sofa cushions are fluffed and arranged neatly for comfort. (r2_s6)

This plan uses the available objects and capabilities to create a welcoming environment for the guest.
plans.R3:
Based on the images of the room, here's a plan to make the space welcoming:

[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the pillow from the bed and place it neatly to make the bed look inviting. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the teddy bear from the floor and place it on the bed for a cozy touch. (r3_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the book from the dresser and place it on the bed as a reading option for the guest. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the small decorative item from the dresser and place it on the bedside table for added decor. (r3_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the small plate from the dresser and place it on the bed as a placeholder for snacks or drinks. (r3_s5)
- R3 [LOCAL] Ensure the room is tidy and welcoming by adjusting any out-of-place items. (r3_s6)

This plan uses the available light objects to create a welcoming atmosphere in the room.
plans.R4:
Based on the image and the capabilities of R4, here's a plan:

[0-5 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Retrieve the spray bottle from the cabinet. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Place the spray bottle on the counter for easy access. (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [ASK_HELP] Request another robot to bring a light snack or drink to the bathroom for the guest. (r4_s3)

This plan ensures that the bathroom is tidy and ready for the guest, with a spray bottle available for any quick cleaning or freshening up.
